text:
ANNERŽİ-YE OMUMI-YE RUZ
Emruz aseman-e Tarazu ba arameshi komak-konande va ziba ba shoma labkhand mizad. Emruz tamarkoz-e shoma ru-ye taadol, zibayi va hal-e khub-e duni hastash. Ehsasat-e duni-ye shoma dar behtarin halat-e khodashan garar darand va mitavanid ba didgahi mosbat be donya negah konid. In ruz baraye kardan-e karhaee ke be shoma aramesh midhand, forsat-e aliei ast.

ESHGH VA RABETE-HA
Baraye kasani ke dar rabete hastand, emruz forsat-e besyar khubi baraye zendegi-ye dobareye eshgh va goftogo-ha-ye samimane ast. Mitavanid kodurat-e ghabli ra kenar begozarid va lahze-ha-ye ashghaneye besazid. Baraye mojarad-ha niz emruz emkan-e ashnavayi ba fardi jadid vojud dard ke mitavanad ghalb-e shoma ra be talatola biyavard; pas dar bargozari-ye ertebat-at jadid baz bashid.

KAR VA KARIYER
Dar mohit-e kari-ye emruz, ba estefade az diplomasi va hoosh-e tabiei-ye khod mitavanid har moshkeli ra hal konid. Farsat-ha-ye jadidi baraye neshon dadan-e estedad-ha-ye shoma be vojood miyad ke nabayad anha ra az dast dahid. Ba hamkaran-e khod ba arman-e hamkari barkhord konid ta natije-ye behtari begirid.

POOL VA BEREKAT
Vaziyat-e mali-ye shoma emruz dar masiri motadel va ro be roshd garar darad. Ba inke momken ast vasvase shavid ta kharid-ha-ye zibayi anjam dahid, ama ba kami modiriyat mitavanid tarazoye mali-ye khod ra hefz konid. In ruz baraye barresi-ye sarmaye-gozari-ha-ye atiye ya barnamerezi-ye mali besyar monaseb ast.

SALAMATI VA ENERŽI
Az nazar-e jesmi va roohani, emruz ehsas-e saboki va neshate khubi darid. Baraye hefz-e in anarji-ye mosbat, varzesh-e sabok ya piade-ravi dar havaye azad ra be shoma pishnahad mikonam. Hamchenin, noshidin-e ab-e kafi va estefade az ghoza-ye salem be shoma dar anarji-ye bishtar komak mikonad.

ERTEBATAT VA MOJAZAT
Rabit-e shoma ba dustan va khanevade emruz besyar garm va samimi khahad bood. Hozur dar jam-ha-ye koochak ya didar ba afradi ke shoma ra doost darand, hal-e roohi-ye shoma ra behtar mikonad. In ruz zibarin forsat ast ta ghalb-e kasani ke baraye shoma aziz hastand ra ba harf-e ziba shad konid.

TAVSIYE-YE RUZ
Hichgah az zibayi-ye sadeye zendegi ghafel nabashid; emruz be khodetat yek hadye-ye koochak bede va labkhand ra be lab-e digaran biyavar.

JAZBIAT-VA-JADOL-E RUZ
Adad-e shans: 6, 12, 24
Rang-e shans: Sorkh-e sorati va abi-ye asemani
Borj-e hamahang: Jowza va Do-Peykar
